text: Jay-Z & Ciara Live (also known as Jay-Z Live with Special Guest Ciara) was a 2009 summer concert tour headlined by American rapper Jay-Z and American R&B singer Ciara, in support of their respective albums The Blueprint 3 and Fantasy Ride. The six-city United States tour took place from July 2 to July 12, 2009, originally scheduled to have ten dates but later reduced to six. The opening act was rapper Fabolous. Ciara did not perform at the first show for an unknown reason but appeared at the second concert at The Palms. The July 12 date in Atlanta, Georgia, was cancelled due to heavy rain. All tour dates were announced and confirmed on Ciara's official website. The tour received positive to favorable reviews from critics. The Los Angeles Times gave the entire tour a very positive review, noting that Ciara worked hard during her brief set, performing impressive acrobatics with her four dancers. Her street-tough image was highlighted through her wearing ripped jeans and leather vests, resembling a sleeked-up girl gang, though her delivery was unfocused and she often appeared unenjoying, lip-syncing to half the songs. The paper also observed that she didn't seem to be enjoying herself. Meanwhile, Jay-Z received a positive review for his energetic and engaging set, which kept the audience highly excited. The review emphasized that Jay-Z's performances are fun because he is exceptionally skilled at crafting sharp, funny, and resonant thoughts using his nimble verbal delivery, and he interacts well with the audience.
